ideas.pitch: An offline-first digital signal processing toolkit powered by edge machine learning for real-time noise reduction and anomaly detection in sensor streams.
ideas.title: SignalPulse AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Since this is hosted by the IEEE Signal Processing Society (SPS), judges will heavily favor rigorous signal processing combined with modern AI models over generic web apps.

ideas.pitch: Satellite and IoT sensor signal analytics platform designed to detect industrial land and power grid compliance violations automatically.
ideas.title: EcoGrid Signal
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages heavy data analysis and geo-spatial sensor monitoring, directly appealing to IEEE SPS technical judges looking for practical infrastructure utility.

ideas.pitch: A localized acoustic biomarker analysis tool that processes voice and respiratory signals to screen for early signs of respiratory distress.
ideas.title: BioVoice Health
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines audio signal processing with healthcare diagnostics, hitting the sweet spot for an IEEE Signal Processing Society event.

ideas.pitch: Graph-based transaction signal intelligence platform that maps money laundering patterns using high-frequency network telemetry.
ideas.title: SonarGraph AML
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly applies advanced graph intelligence and telemetry analysis, echoing proven winning patterns from high-level technical hackathons.

ideas.pitch: An offline multi-agent student tutor leveraging local vector embeddings and signal-based retrieval augmentation for instant academic query resolution.
ideas.title: NeuroStream RAG
ideas.why_it_could_win: Fits a tight 10-hour offline hackathon format by relying on pre-packaged open-source AI pipelines and a clean local interface.
